name: HyperX Pulsefire mice (HP ids)
description: Per-LED lighting of the HyperX Pulsefire mice with HP product ids: Surge, Core, Dart (wired and wireless), Haste. Same code as plugins/hyperx-mouse (a plugin has one vendor id). Adapted from OpenRGB's HyperXMouseController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Only Direct colour reports are sent: never the Dart's save-to-memory command, never DPI, polling rate or profile settings. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/hyperx-mouse.md.
